chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I said to Abī Ibrāhīm عليه السلام: A man performs tamattu', then forgets to shorten his hair until he enters into iḥrām for hajj. So he said: A blood-offering is upon him, which he must spill.

key_terms.دَمٌ: a sacrificial blood-offering due as expiation
key_terms.يُقَصِّرَ: to shorten the hair as the required taqsir rite
key_terms.يُهَرِيقُهُ: he sheds it, meaning he offers the sacrificial animal
key_terms.يُهِلَّ: to commence the state of iḥrām with talbiyah for hajj

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets taqsir in tamattu' until entering ihram for hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one performing Hajj al-Tamattu' who forgets taqsir before entering into ihram for hajj. Imam Abī Ibrāhīm عليه السلام rules that such a person must offer a sacrificial blood-offering as expiation.
